notes.title: Patch v1.19
notes.content:
* Mixed levels now unlock with both intermediate and learning difficulties open.

This means you should never have to complete a minigame on learning difficulty more than once.

tags.feature: * Mixed levels now unlock with both intermediate and learning difficulties open.

notes.title: Patch 1.18 - Controller support for Windows 32 / 64
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33163651/39e5bcb6338cb074caa1394bf741da8cdafc6728.png[/img]

Controller support has now been released on the Windows builds for MultiTaskMaster.

Please be aware that controller support is not yet implemented on Mac OS or Linux.

Mouse and Keyboard is still the recommended way to play MultiTaskMaster.

Default Control Map is as follows:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33163651/e151d5de2e6e00c984f3636b8d6229022c57a5c8.jpg[/img]

Edit: Forgot to mention. Also fixed a bug where instead of swapping screens a level would just shut one screen off.

tags.feature: Controller support has now been released on the Windows builds for MultiTaskMaster.

notes.title: Patch 1.14 - 64 Bit versions for Windows / Linux
notes.content:
In this patch I have added 64 bit versions for Windows and Linux to see if I can further improve performance.

Everything seems to be working but please let me know here, in the community hub or email me at contact@wyvernware.net if you encounter any issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.13 - Balance
notes.content:
* Bank Job - Hostages Reaction time increased.
* Bank Job - Bullet Dodge - Bullets fire less frequently. Reaction time increased at expert level.

* Police Chase - Fog density lowered.
* Police Chase - Vehicles turn speed increases with speed level.
* Road speed adjusted. Slightly faster on lower difficulty and slightly slower at higher difficulty.

* Cafe - Plate responsiveness increases with speed level.
* Cafe - Coffee reaction time increased.

* Factory - Log Chop reaction time increased.
* Factory - Carve Wood reaction time increased.
* Factory - Sort heads - Fall speed reduced.
* Factory - Attach Heads - stutter wait time increased, less heads to attach per cycle

* Train - Rail Speed increased... a lot.

* Training Montage - run speed decreased at higher difficulties.
* Training Montage - Skipping speed reduced

* Fete - TugOWar maximum difficulty reduced.
* Fete - Hook a duck audio cue improved and speed reduced.
* Fete - Coconut Shy reaction speed increased.
* Fete - Hoopla speed reduced and miss chances set to 6 for all difficulties

* Zombie Siege - Zombies knock down more barricade planks at once.
* Zombie Siege - Less zombies climb up to the roof but they attack faster.
* Zombie Siege - Battery loses more charge but less frequently.

* Space Battle - Interceptors are fewer but attack quicker.
* Space Battle - Asteroids are slower and fewer but larger.
* Space Battle - Guide Missile flight time increased. Lateral speed increases with speed level.

* Fantasy Arena - Fighter's opponents approach slower.
* Fantasy Arena - Less Bats that approach slower.
* Fantasy Arena - Healer's DDR game slowed down.

Fixed - Robbers sometimes stop throwing debris on chase level.
Fixed - Sometimes lose control of Tony on Zombie Level
Fixed - Lazer sometimes doesn't turn off on Factory Level
Fixed - Level End countdown continues after premature death.

I changed a lot of stuff. Let me know what you think and if my fixes break anything new.

Cheers,
Wyvern

* Truck wheels spin faster.
* 300% speed achievements now awarded correctly.

notes.title: Patch 1.11 - Tutorial-Armageddon
notes.content:
* Levels have been shortened slightly again.
* Learner difficulty tutorials will now only run on the main levels and not on mixed levels and random levels.

This means there are now 60% less tutorials in MultiTaskMaster. If you never fail a learner level you will only have one tutorial for each mini-game.

tags.balance_change: * Levels have been shortened slightly again.

tags.feature: Learner difficulty tutorials will now only run on the main levels and not on mixed levels and random levels.

notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.content:
* Intermediate and Expert levels shortened a second time.
* Achievements balanced to take into account shorter levels.
* Steam Achievements updated to match in game achievements.
* Changing music volume takes effect immediately
* Police Chase Cam made easier

Please let me know what you think about the shorter, snappier levels.

Also, this update should work fine with pre-existing save files. But if you have problems please let me know here so I can investigate.
